description: The Newport 4 Drawer Chest combines generous storage with a compact footprint, making it a smart choice for smaller nurseries. Four dovetailed drawers with smooth full-extension glides hold everything from newborn sleepers to toddler jeans. The solid hardwood construction and warm Brown Maple finish ensure lasting durability and timeless appeal. Use the spacious top for a changing pad or display favorite nursery decor. Coordinates with the complete Newport collection. Non-toxic, baby-safe finish throughout.
